items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard r-and-b at the little – I don’t know what you would call it. It was like a – what was it like? It was a little restaurant, little hangout place where teenagers went. I heard Little Esther and Dinah Washington, Laverne Baker, Ruth Brown.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Billy Eckstine, Little Jimmy Scott. I heard r-and-b at the little – I don’t know what you would call it. It was like a – what was it like? It was a little restaurant, little hangout place where teenagers went. I heard Little Esther and Dinah Washington, Laverne Baker, Ruth Brown. So that’s when I – I had to be maybe 12 or so when I started – when I really recall hearing r-and-b.
Radio was WDKL? Is that the . . . ?
